description: The difficulties the New Game picker shows, in order. label: the text shown; base_difficulty: the game's difficulty the entry plays as (-1 easy, 0 normal, 1 hard), which drives saves, enemy spawns and the grab-escape counts of config/gameplay.json. Extra entries are presets over these three bases. "default": true preselects an entry. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
